study_note: D512-1-J6 (Full-width 1:1 baseline) in the base-v2 single-seed exploratory Humanoid Walk inner-loop update-schedule study. It uses J=6, N=512 rollouts per round, H=3, batch size 512, and shared G=1 joint updates per round, for 3,072 total imagined rollouts, 9,216 imagined transitions, 6 critic, 6 actor, and 6 automatic-temperature updates across 6 joint update slots per real action. Replay capacity is 9,216, matching the per-action model-step budget. All non-inner-schedule algorithm settings, training-focused evaluation gates, 14-million-decision budget, seed 55, and no-model-checkpoint policy are inherited unchanged from base-v2. This remains a single-seed exploratory variant and supports no confidence, significance, or confirmatory claim.
